main_text.l: Dei, Gen.32.1. Aff. מַלְאָכֵי Nunciorum suorum, 2.Par.36.15. מַלְאֲכֵיכֶם Nunciorum tuorum, Nah.2.13. cum Tzere loco Kametz. Chald. מַלְאָכָה Angelum suum, Dan.3.28.
מַלְאָכוּת f. Legatio: Constructus. בְּמַלְאֲכוֹת יְהוָה In legatione Domini, Haggai 1.13.

מְלָאכָה f. Opus; Functio; Artificium, Ars. Kimchi vult, sic esse pro מְלָאכָה forma מְמַלְכָה [?], ut liquet etiam ex plurali constructo. Significatur autem hoc nomine Res & substantia quaevis, circa quam Opera & industria collocatur, ut 1.Sam.15.9. & Gen.33.14. Constr. עֹור מְלֶאכֶת Opere pelliceo, Lev.13.48. Semel cum defectu א; לְמְלֶאכֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם Operi coelorum, Jer.7.18. quod repetitur Jer.44.17. R.Salomon; Reginae coelorum, quasi à מלכה [?]. Aff. לִמְלַאכְתּוֹ Operi suo, 2.Par.8.9. Plural. מְלָאכוֹת. Constr. מְלֶאכוֹת הַתַּבְנִית Opera structurae, 1.Paral.28.19. Aff. מְלַאכוֹתֶיךָ Opera tua, Psal.73.28.

לָבָא m. Leo immanis, & annosus quidem, sed decrepito, qui לִיש dicitur, junior; cum dentes molares ei attribuantur, Joel.1.6. Et Catulus, Job.4.11. vide ארה. Plural. לְבָאִים Immanes leones, Psal.75.5. Fœm. לְבִיא Leaena, Ezech.19.2. Plur. cum Aff. לְלִבְאֹתָיו Leanis suis, Nah.2.12. Quidam à sequenti Nomine deducunt, quasi Leonem cordatum & animosum dicas.

לֵב m. Cor, Animus: Constru. לֵב אֱנוֹשׁ Cor hominis, Psal.104.15. בְּלֵב יַמִּים In cor marium, id est, Intimam partem, quia cor est in intima parte pectoris, Jon.2.4. Sic, ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ τῆς γῆς In corde terrae, Matt.12.30 [?]. Et Virg. Detumëre animi maris. Aff. בְּלִבְּךָ In animo tuo, Deuter.9.4. לִבָּם Cor vestrum, Num.35.19. Plural. cum Aff. לִבֵּיהֶן Ad corda sua, Nah.2.7. Et for-mâ fœ-

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms in the dense lines (מְלֶאכֶת, למלאכת, מלכה, לִבֵּיהֶן) are read from a small scan and may be imperfect. The reference "Matt.12.30" appears as printed, but the usual reading is 12.40; marked [?]. The Hebrew in the first entry line "מַלְאֲכֵיכֶם" is uncertain.
